HomeCredentialingArtificial Intelligence Fundamentals Certificate
Work Smarter Not Harder With AI Fundamentals
Hone and prove your ability to leverage AI technology.
START LEARNING
Take a look at our AI Fundamentals Certificate
AI Fundamentals instructs through a hybrid learning approach to help you build an understanding of AI concepts, principles and uses. Learn how to utilize essential software and algorithms to leverage AI’s applications and potential to streamline your career by automating complex tasks.
Who would benefit from AI Fundamentals:
STUDENTS & RECENT GRADUATES
TEAMS & INDIVIDUALS LOOKING TO UPSKILL
PROFESSIONALS NEW TO IT
What you will learn with AI Fundamentals:
AI focuses on building smart machines capable of performing tasks that typically require humans and is drastically increasing in demand as it continues to change the future of virtually every field of technology. With AI Fundamentals, you’ll learn how understanding AI’s risks and potential can fast-track your career.
AI Principals, Concepts & Potential Uses
Essential Software & Algorithms for AI Applications & Possibilities
AI Associated Risks & Ethical Requirements
VIEW ALL Study Materials
HOW DO I BECOME CERTIFIED?
Build a world-class team
ISACA certifications instantly declare your team’s expertise in building and implementing and managing solutions aligned with organizational needs and goals.
TALK TO OUR EXPERTS
Learn, train and grow with AI Fundamentals
Build an understanding of AI and its use with your choice of guidance and self-paced study developed by industry-leading experts.
Resources to get started
AI Fundamentals Online Course
This interactive, self-guided course blends knowledge and performance-based training components to help you master key AI principles, models, and infrastructure. You’ll be able to access your study materials and performance-based labs on demand—and you’ll earn 5 CPE upon completion. BUY COURSE
AI Fundamentals Lab Package
Access online labs to help you build and reinforce the skills required to master critical AI principles and concepts. Labs include Machine Learning Models, Security Implementations of AI, and Robotic Process Automation. Once purchased, labs are available on-demand for six months. You’ll also earn 4.5 CPE upon completion. BUY PACKAGE
AI Fundamentals Study Guide
Expand your knowledge of AI Fundamentals domains, learn how to best prepare for the exam, and solve example questions complete with recommended answers with our study guide authored by AI experts. BUY GUIDE
TRAIN YOUR CORPORATE TEAM

There are no prerequisites. You can register for the AI Fundamentals Exam at any time. The online, remotely proctored 2-hour exam is a multiple choice exam.
To pass the exam, you must earn a score of 65% or higher.

Review the Exam Candidate Guide to learn about exam registration, scheduling, preparation, rules, administration, scoring, retake policy, proctoring and more.

Seamless certificate journey
ISACA’S AI Fundamentals certificate exam is computer-based and administered via remotely proctored exams. AI Fundamentals exam registration is continuous, meaning candidates can register any time, no restrictions. Candidates can schedule a testing appointment as early as 48 hours after payment of exam registration fees.
Log in to MyISACA or create an account to begin
If you are creating an account, please ensure your name matches what appears on your government-issued identification that you will present on the day of your AI Fundamentals exam.
LOG IN TO MYISACA Become A Member
Schedule
Schedule your exam
AI Fundamentals exam eligibility is required to schedule and take the exam. Eligibility is established at the time of exam registration and is good for six months. Exam registration and payment are required before you can schedule and take an exam. These are the key steps to scheduling your AI Fundamentals exam:
Resources to help schedule your exam:
Exam guides
Special accommodations
Log in to your ISACA Account >
Click Certificates
Click Schedule Your Exam or Visit Exam Website, you will be taken to the PSI dashboard to schedule your exam.
On the PSI dashboard, click Schedule Exam.
Please note, exam appointments are only available 90 days in advance. If you do not see your exam site or date available more than 90 days in advance, please check back when it is closer to your desired exam date. If you still do not see your desired exam site or date available, please verify that your AI Fundamentals exam eligibility has not expired by logging into your ISACA Account, and clicking the Certification & CPE Management tab.
Rescheduling an exam
You can reschedule your AI Fundamentals exam anytime, without penalty, during your eligibility period if done a minimum of 48 hours prior to your scheduled testing appointment. To reschedule an appointment: Log in to your ISACA Account and follow the rescheduling steps in the Scheduling Guide.
LOG IN TO MYISACA
How to access your certificate
With a score of 65% or higher you will be notified of your achievement (congrats!). Then log in to your MyISACA certificate page.
